description: Controller sync bodies (protocol/sync.md). Every valid body passes its kind's check (games, events, scores, nodes); nodes_unknown_info_dropped keeps only the info keys listed under info. Every invalid body fails with the error code and path given (the first problem found, in the order of protocol/sync.md's tables). merge: the snapshots merged in order by maximum per (source, team) give counters, and the totals are the counters' sum per team plus the deltas (GM adjustments, score.delta), worked out by hand from protocol/sync.md's rule (decision P4R10).

merge.name: a negative GM adjustment lowers the total; a late older snapshot changes nothing
a standby controller's snapshot of the same game: the same nodes merge, each controller's field runs add
